label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — User-controlled param from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to host variable, which is used in URL construction at line 43 (new java.net.URL('http://' + host + '/api').openStream()). While isNonPublicAddress() performs basic filtering, it only blocks loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local addresses and allows external IPs. Attackers can provide hostnames resolving to arbitrary external servers (including cloud instances, internal networks, or their own machines) that pass the isNonPublicAddress check. The resolved sink value at line 43 is the user-controlled host parameter, making this a valid SSRF vulnerability.

evidence.note: host assigned from param, minimal validation via isNonPublicAddress()
Sink: new java.net.URL('http://' + host + '/api').openStream() - user-controlled host used in outbound HTTP request
